body.p: Two shamans. There were two great shamans. The first shaman said: "Well, let's go to a warm place. There the swans pass the winter!" The other shaman said: "Fine! Let's go!" Then the shamans turned into swans. Having shapeshifted they flew to the warm land. They were flying and flying, they came there, in the land it is warm. All swans were passing the summer. The one shaman said: "Now let's pass the summer!" "Well", the other shaman said. The first shaman said: "Where do we pass the summer? I'll pass the summer alone!" The other shaman said: "I'll pass the summer together with the swans!" So they did. The first shaman flew off, there he passed the summer. The other shaman stayed. The swans recognized the shaman, having recognized [him] they killed the shaman.
